posts.trend: ₹16,500 rent, ₹12,000 iPhone EMI: Mumbai founder reveals her ₹52,000 monthly expenses
posts.context: Urban Indians are spending more on the tools that project wealth than on the actual shelter they live in.
posts.angle: Adulthood in a metro is just upgrading the camera you use to photograph a life that hasn't changed.
slides: Your expenses have undergone a shift in priorities.

At 21: You slept on a thin mattress and owned a ₹10,000 phone.

At 30: You sleep on a thin mattress and own a ₹1,20,000 phone.

The mattress is still on the floor.

But the camera quality is excellent.
posts.caption: At least the struggle looks cinematic now. 🎬
posts.rank_verdict: The hook is extremely boring and lacks any tension to make the reader swipe.
